chest_charm.png.rule: border-connected shirt white (lum > 236, sat < 18) and bow navy (b > r + 20, lum < 110), then the shirt shade (lum > 212, sat < 22) touching it except within 2 px of gold and gems, made transparent; islands under 24 px dropped; the edge a soft matte (kept mask closed 1 px, blurred 1.2 px)

bodice.png.rule: under the charm (its rest box + 6 units sideways, from 14 units below its top (under the knot) to 10 units below its bottom): every pixel that is not plain shirt white (lum > 224, sat < 16) filled by repeated neighbour averaging seeded from the shirt pixels only
